population: Released AI4I 2020 records, grouped by the source Type field
denominator: Records in the selected product type; each UDI contributes once
timeBasis: The released table supplies record identifiers rather than observation timestamps

measures.machineFailure: Count of rows whose published Machine failure label is 1
measures.anyModeFlag: Count of rows carrying at least one of TWF, HDF, PWF, OSF or RNF
measures.modeFlagTotal: Sum of mode memberships; one record can contribute to several modes
measures.multipleModeFlags: Count of rows carrying at least two mode flags
measures.rate: 100 times the selected count divided by population records; empty population is unavailable

bins.interval: Lower edge included, upper edge excluded; the final upper edge is included
bins.cellOrder: torqueIndex * 10 + speedIndex; both indexes ascend from zero
bins.outOfRangeRule: Out-of-range records remain in population summaries; reason counts may overlap
